maintainer: edit freely: curated_open = true / false / null. Set your own referral/joint-link in 'your_ref_url' to earn commissions from clicks on this site.

platforms.name: ySense
platforms.notes: One of the most reliable routers Nigerians actually receive paid surveys on. Fill your profile 100% to get more invites.

platforms.name: Timebucks
platforms.notes: Very Africa-friendly. Extras like Real Tasks (photos, traffic, search) pay well from Nigeria. Crypto payout avoids PayPal headaches.

platforms.name: Freecash
platforms.notes: Fast payouts and many survey partners. Popular with Nigerian users.

platforms.name: Triaba
platforms.notes: Global router with African panels. Smaller rewards but steady invites from Nigeria.

platforms.name: MOBROG
platforms.notes: Runs Nigeria panels from time to time. Confirm Nigeria appears in the country list at signup.

platforms.name: CashKarma
platforms.notes: Android/iOS app that accepts a wide list of countries including Nigeria.

platforms.name: GrabPoints
platforms.notes: Long-running GPT site. Some offer walls geo-limit NG, but signup is open for Nigeria.

platforms.name: OfferNation
platforms.notes: Pays well on offer walls. Accepts most countries including Nigeria.

platforms.name: Pawns.app
platforms.notes: Surveys plus passive internet-sharing income. Works from a Nigerian phone.

platforms.name: AttaPoll
platforms.notes: Survey app with active presence in Africa. Low payout, quick surveys.

platforms.name: YouGov
platforms.notes: Respected research company with an African/Nigeria panel. Pick Nigeria in the country selector at signup.

platforms.name: LifePoints
platforms.notes: Big global panel; Nigerian members report regular invites.

platforms.name: Toluna Influencers
platforms.notes: Choose Nigeria in the country selector at signup; a dedicated NG portal usually exists.

platforms.name: The Panel Station
platforms.notes: Focuses on emerging markets; Nigerian membership has historically been available.

platforms.name: Premise
platforms.notes: Get paid for local price checks and photo tasks around you. Very active in Nigerian cities.

platforms.name: Streetbees
platforms.notes: Short video/photo tasks. Nigerian availability is occasional - grab it when tasks appear.

platforms.name: Cointiply
platforms.notes: Pays only in crypto, which is convenient for Nigerians without PayPal.

platforms.name: PremioCash
platforms.notes: Built for African users. Low entry point and mobile-money payouts.

platforms.name: Survey Junkie
platforms.notes: Restricted to US, Canada and Australia. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Branded Surveys
platforms.notes: US/UK/CA only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Swagbucks
platforms.notes: Country list changes but Nigeria is generally NOT accepted.

platforms.name: MyPoints
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: InboxDollars
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Opinion Outpost
platforms.notes: US/UK/CA and a few EU markets. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: Ipsos i-Say
platforms.notes: Runs panels in selected countries; no Nigerian panel.

platforms.name: Prolific
platforms.notes: Pays great rates but Nigeria is not an eligible signup country.

platforms.name: Kashkick
platforms.notes: US only. Nigeria is NOT accepted.

platforms.name: American Consumer Opinion
platforms.notes: Global brand but surveys rarely target Nigeria. Treat as restricted.

platforms.name: Superpay.me
platforms.notes: Very low payout threshold. Verify Nigeria is accepted at signup - the daily checker will help.

platforms.name: Rewarding Ways
platforms.notes: Same family as Superpay.me. Dual-category status until confirmed.

platforms.name: InstaGC
platforms.notes: Some offers work internationally. Confirm NG availability at signup.

platforms.name: PaidViewpoint
platforms.notes: TraitSurveys pay small but reliably. Signups vary by country - verify NG.

platforms.name: Google Opinion Rewards
platforms.notes: Not officially available for Nigerian accounts. Install may fail in the Play Store.

platforms.name: Poll Pay
platforms.notes: Country availability varies per store region - verify from your phone.

platforms.name: Zap Surveys
platforms.notes: High minimum. NG acceptance reported inconsistently - verify.

platforms.name: Jumia Nigeria Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Promote Jumia product links; earn % of every order (fashion/phones/home sell best)
platforms.notes: Nigeria's biggest marketplace. Perfect to push on WhatsApp, X, TikTok and a simple product list page.

platforms.name: Konga Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Commission on Konga orders from your links/banners
platforms.notes: Second big NG marketplace. Run both Jumia + Konga and compare which converts for your audience.

platforms.name: Expertnaire
platforms.earn_model: Sell NG digital courses (freelancing, web design, forex...) for large Naira commissions
platforms.notes: Very popular in Nigeria. Commissions are big but you must learn to market honestly - no fake income promises.

platforms.name: Selar Affiliates
platforms.earn_model: Promote creators' ebooks/courses on Selar; commission per sale
platforms.notes: Join through Selar's affiliate section after signup. Bonus: you can also SELL YOUR OWN design templates there.

platforms.name: Fiverr Affiliates
platforms.earn_model: Send buyers to Fiverr gigs; earn per sign-up/first order
platforms.notes: Nigerian designers can earn by sending leads for gigs they don't offer themselves (logo, SEO, apps...).

platforms.name: Hostinger Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Bundle hosting inside your web-design package and earn on every signup
platforms.notes: Perfect for web designers: quote client 'domain + hosting + website' packages and pocket the hosting commission too.

platforms.name: systeme.io Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Recurring income: keep earning monthly while your funnels/clients stay on it
platforms.notes: Pair with your own funnel-setup service. Recurring beats one-time money.

platforms.name: Elementor Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Earn when clients/audience upgrade WordPress with Elementor Pro
platforms.notes: Strongest fit for you: recommend to every WordPress project you deliver and upsell in maintenance retainers.

platforms.name: Canva Affiliates
platforms.earn_model: Earn when creators subscribe to Canva Pro via your tutorials/templates
platforms.notes: Post design tutorials in NG communities; affiliate link under each - teach and earn.

platforms.name: Binance Referral Program
platforms.earn_model: Share signup referral link; earn commission on friends' trading fees
platforms.notes: Join from your Binance profile (Referral). Only promote to people who already trade - avoid pressure.

platforms.name: Payoneer Refer a Friend
platforms.earn_model: Refer freelancers/buyers to Payoneer; bonus when they receive payments
platforms.notes: Useful combo: your freelance and affiliate audiences all need a way to get paid.

platforms.name: Amazon Associates
platforms.earn_model: Product reviews/lists with clicks to Amazon
platforms.notes: Applications from Nigeria are accepted irregularly and approval varies - verify and follow their payout rules.

platforms.name: WP Engine Affiliates
platforms.earn_model: High-ticket hosting payouts for premium WordPress projects
platforms.notes: One sale covers a client laptop repair - verify NG acceptance at signup.

platforms.name: Temu Affiliate
platforms.earn_model: Promote Temu deals; commission on new users' orders
platforms.notes: Temu's site already targets NG traffic (cheap gadgets sell fast), but affiliate-program acceptance for Nigerian accounts is unconfirmed - apply and verify; the daily checker watches the page for you.

platforms.name: Fiverr (sell gigs)
platforms.earn_model: Package web design gigs: landing pages, redesigns, WordPress fixes, monthly care plans
platforms.notes: Start with 3 tight gigs + samples in your portfolio. NG accounts are fully supported.

platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.earn_model: Client proposals - higher budgets than Fiverr; set Connects budget
platforms.notes: Strong for web designers: hourly + fixed contracts. Build profile with your Survey Hunter site as proof.

platforms.name: Freelancer.com
platforms.earn_model: Contests + projects; enter logo/web contests to build reviews
platforms.notes: Heavy competition but good for early portfolio pieces and NG-friendly payouts.

platforms.name: Truelancer
platforms.earn_model: Smaller than Upwork but less competition for quick deliverables
platforms.notes: Accepts Nigerian freelancers; decent starter volume while Upwork profile matures.

platforms.name: PeoplePerHour
platforms.earn_model: Hourlies (fixed offers) + client proposals, UK/EU buyers
platforms.notes: Verify NG onboarding at signup - availability is reported inconsistently.

platforms.name: We Work Remotely
platforms.earn_model: Full-remote design/dev roles paying in USD; apply to listings daily
platforms.notes: Free to browse. Put 'open to working with remote systems' + portfolio site in every application.

platforms.name: Toptal
platforms.notes: Screens to roughly the top 3% worldwide - long English skills + portfolio + live interviews. Not a beginner platform; revisit after 1-2 years of solid work.

platforms.name: OPay Referrals
platforms.earn_model: Invite friends to join/use OPay; Naira bonuses land in your wallet
platforms.notes: Widely used NG money app - referral rewards change by campaign, check the app's 'Invite' tab.

platforms.name: PalmPay Referrals
platforms.earn_model: Share invite code; earn when friends signup & transact (cashback apps too)
platforms.notes: Check the app's referral/rewards section for current bonus amounts.

platforms.name: Moniepoint
platforms.earn_model: Become a POS agent or refer merchants; commissions on transactions
platforms.notes: Agent-model: if you have a small business, Moniepoint POS terminals can earn transaction commissions. Verify current referral offer in-app.

platforms.name: PiggyVest Referrals
platforms.earn_model: Invite people to start saving; bonuses when they save/verify (often 1,000-ish)
platforms.notes: Huge among NG students/ creators: save + refer content performs well on socials.

platforms.name: Cowrywise
platforms.earn_model: Referral campaign credits for inviting savers
platforms.notes: Simple share-and-earn in-app. Combine PiggyVest + Cowrywise content as one 'start saving' post series.

platforms.name: Risevest
platforms.earn_model: Invite friends to invest in Dollar plans; referral cash bonuses
platforms.notes: Dollar-investment angle sells to salary earners - do honest, no-hype posts.

platforms.name: Chipper Cash
platforms.earn_model: Invite friends to send/receive money; bonus per qualifying signup
platforms.notes: Bonus amounts change by campaign - check the app's invite section.

platforms.name: Kuda MFB
platforms.earn_model: Referral rewards when active when they run campaigns - verify in-app first
platforms.notes: Kuda runs referral drives in waves. When OFF, there is no reward - so confirm before promoting.

platforms.name: Bybit Referral
platforms.earn_model: Share signup link; earn commission + campaign bonuses
platforms.notes: For audiences already trading. Same ethics as Binance: never pressure anyone into crypto.

platforms.name: Remitano
platforms.earn_model: Referral commission on P2P trades
platforms.notes: Active with Nigerian P2P traders - verify current terms before promoting.
